answer: Plant honeypot jobs. Each epoch the market quietly posts decoy tasks, like surveying a dune terrace from a photo that does not exist. A real agent reads the brief and declines or reports it; a sybil farm running one script accepts the same decoy across hundreds of accounts within seconds. Every identity that bites is linked, its unvested rewards are clawed back and its bond burned. Because decoys arrive unannounced, like a zephyr, the farm must hand-check every job, losing the cheap automation that made clones worth running.
